dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Dataset developed according to Arcadia project Methodology (Report: “Metodologia per gli studi di filiera della Banca Dati italiana LCA”). LCA study of electricity production from photovoltaic in Italy (Report: “Filiera di produzione del mix elettrico italiano”). The dataset refers to the production of 1 kWh of electricity from electrical mix in low voltage, in Italy, which only concerns the production of electricity from photovoltaics and it is representative of the processing technologies commonly used for this purpose. The dataset consists of 2 processes: 1) Electricity from photovoltaic, 570 kWp, open ground installation, multi-Si, production mix at plant, Low Voltage (percentage contribution to the whole dataset: 61%). 2) Electricity production, photovoltaic, 3 kWp, general (percentage contribution to the whole dataset: 39%).

referenceToExternalDocumentation.common:shortDescription:
Gabriella Fiorentino, Simona Scalbi, Antonietta Cerbone, Giuliana Ansanelli, Marco Giammartini, Amalia Zucaro. Filiera di produzione del mix elettrico italiano.
Background datasets from EcoInvent database cut-off (v.3.7.1) were used for the LCA study.

time.common:timeRepresentativenessDescription: This dataset has been considered valid until 2026, since no main changes have occurred in the electricity mix in Italy in the investigated years.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse: The dataset (1 kWh of electricity from photovoltaic, in Italy) refers to a system that includes all processes, from the extraction of raw materials to produce the photovoltaic panels to the production of 1 kWh of electricity (cradle-to-gate approach), taking into account the 20-year life time of the system and the insolation received in the reference year (primary data). The primary data were provided by GSE (Gestore Servizi Energetici), 2019 and 2020, photovoltaic solar statistical report, and via the PVGIS software that calculates the insolation received. For the LCA study, background datasets from EcoInvent database 3.7.1 cut-off were used.
technology.technologicalApplicability: Electricity from Italian electricity mix sold to Italian electric grid.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.dataCutOffAndCompletenessPrinciples: Production of equipment and infrastructures is not included, except for the background system

review.common:reviewDetails: The review was performed in compliance with Arcadia Metodology: “Metodologia per gli studi di filiera della Banca Dati italiana LCA” and ISO 14040-44 norms. The dataset has been assessed limited to the foreground data collected during the supply chain studies. Each dataset has been evaluated based on the following 4 criteria: 1. Technological Representativeness; 2. Time Representativeness; 3. Geographical Representativeness; 4. Reliability (A) In this context, the Reliability is very good.
review.common:otherReviewDetails: The study was judged by the reviewer as compliant with both ISO 14040-44 and Arcadia methodology.
